items.prompt: An entry magnitude has square a/b>0. After scaling to millionths, k=floor(sqrt(a*10^12/b)). What comparison locates its rounding midpoint?

options.why: This compares the exact nonnegative squared value with (k+1/2)^2 without approximate square roots.

options.text: a versus b, regardless of k.
options.why: That only compares the unscaled magnitude with 1, not the current half-unit midpoint.

options.text: The last digit of a floating printout.
options.why: That printout may already have lost the exact midpoint relationship.

options.text: k versus the original matrix diagonal.
options.why: A factor entry midpoint depends on its rational square, not that raw diagonal comparison.

items.explanation: This compares the exact nonnegative squared value with (k+1/2)^2 without approximate square roots.
